name: beigecheck
description: Checks the writing your AI tool does for your company against your approved facts, brand voice and house rules.

interface.longDescription:
BeigeCheck checks the writing your AI tool does for your company. It gives the tool your approved facts, brand voice and house rules to write from, then checks each draft against them.

Ask for a proposal, a post or an email and name BeigeCheck. Your AI tool gets the voice brief and the facts it needs and writes the draft. BeigeCheck then scores it and flags sentences that read as AI-written, claims your approved facts don't back, and words your company avoids, so your AI tool can fix them before you see the draft.

You can also ask BeigeCheck to check writing you've done yourself, tell you what's new at your company, say whether an approver has signed off a draft you sent, or show how it describes your own writing.

BeigeCheck only reads. Your owners and approvers change the company's facts, voice and rules in the BeigeCheck web app, where every change keeps its history. You need a BeigeCheck account for your company to use it.
capabilities: Your company's voice brief and house rules
Approved facts, each with its source
Checks drafts against your voice and facts
What's newly approved at your company
Where your drafts stand for sign-off
defaultPrompt: Use BeigeCheck to write a LinkedIn post about our newest client.
Use BeigeCheck to check this email before I send it.

positive.prompt: Use BeigeCheck to write a short LinkedIn post about our work with councils.
positive.expected_behavior: A post that uses only Quillbrook's approved facts, checked, with the Beige-ometer panel and the score line under it.

positive.prompt: Use BeigeCheck to check this before I post it: "We are the leading bid writers in the UK and have won hundreds of contracts."
positive.expected_behavior: The changes listed, including the claim the facts don't back, and an offer to make them. The text isn't rewritten unasked.

positive.prompt: Ask BeigeCheck what we've approved about our track record.
positive.expected_behavior: The approved facts, each with where it came from.
What's been approved in the last 30 days, by kind, or a plain sentence saying nothing's new.

positive.prompt: Has my draft been approved in BeigeCheck?
positive.expected_behavior: The drafts sent for sign-off and where each stands, or a sentence saying none have been sent.

negative.description: General knowledge, nothing to do with the company
Personal writing that isn't for the company
negative.prompt: Write a limerick about my cat.

review.commerce_description: BeigeCheck doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: BeigeCheck's panel now shows once, under the finished draft. The checks ChatGPT makes while it revises run quietly, so each revision no longer adds a panel to the chat.
